title: Accept Forgejo webhook deliveries
spec: Add the Forgejo webhook handler. Bodies above 1 MiB are rejected with 413, the HMAC signature in X-Forgejo-Signature is verified in constant time before parsing.
acceptance_criteria: bodies above 1 MiB are rejected with 413 without reading them fully
the signature is verified with hmac.Equal before the body is parsed
an HTTP test covers a valid, an invalid and an oversized delivery
pr_body: Handler plus tests for valid and invalid signatures.

defects.note: the body is read without http.MaxBytesReader or io.LimitReader and the 413 check happens after the full read
no test sends an oversized delivery
